# Display snippets for docs/yaml.md

--8<-- [start:read_sig]
Read(+YamlString, -Data)
--8<-- [end:read_sig]

--8<-- [start:read_all_sig]
ReadAll(+YamlString, -DocList)
--8<-- [end:read_all_sig]

--8<-- [start:read_file_sig]
ReadFile(+Path, -Data)
--8<-- [end:read_file_sig]

--8<-- [start:write_sig]
write(+Data, -YamlString)
--8<-- [end:write_sig]

--8<-- [start:write_all_sig]
WriteAll(+DocList, -YamlString)
--8<-- [end:write_all_sig]

--8<-- [start:write_file_sig]
WriteFile(+Path, +Data)
--8<-- [end:write_file_sig]

--8<-- [start:get_sig]
Get(+Data, +Path, -Value)
--8<-- [end:get_sig]

--8<-- [start:parse_config]
-import_from(yaml_module, [ReadFile, Get])

DbConfig(PATH, HOST, PORT, NAME) <- (
    ReadFile(PATH, CFG),
    Get(CFG, ["database", "host"], HOST),
    Get(CFG, ["database", "port"], PORT),
    Get(CFG, ["database", "name"], NAME)
)
--8<-- [end:parse_config]

--8<-- [start:round_trip]
-import_from(yaml_module, [Read, write, Get])

RoundTrip(YAML, KEY, VAL) <- (
    Read(YAML, D),
    write(D, S),
    Read(S, D2),
    Get(D2, KEY, VAL)
)
--8<-- [end:round_trip]

--8<-- [start:k8s_manifests]
-import_from(yaml_module, [ReadAll, Get])

ServiceNames(YAML, NAMES) <- (
    ReadAll(YAML, DOCS),
    maplist([D, N] >> Get(D, ["metadata", "name"], N), DOCS, NAMES)
)
--8<-- [end:k8s_manifests]

--8<-- [start:python_interop]
-import_from(yaml_module, [Read])

AllKeys(YAML, KEYS) <- (
    Read(YAML, D),
    KEYS is ++(list(D.keys()))
)
--8<-- [end:python_interop]
